literal_sequence.step0_clean_shell: \exec /usr/bin/env -i PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin' HOME='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-home' TERM='xterm-256color' LANG='C' LC_ALL='C' CODESPACES="${CODESPACES:-}" CODESPACE_NAME="${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" GH_CONFIG_DIR='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-gh-auth' PYTHONNOUSERSITE='1' /bin/bash --noprofile --norc
literal_sequence.step1_define_external_verifier_bootstrap:
set +e
set +x
set -u
umask 077
CANONICAL_SHA='74ea95e59ac0654e1a0c1f811a178b3eef7b073c'
CANONICAL_ORIGIN='https://github.com/fufufu1116/multiverse-research.git'
EXEC_ROOT='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-execution'
EMPTY_TEMPLATE='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-empty-git-template'
SESSION_ROOT='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-session-state'
git_clean() {
  command env -i PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin' HOME="$HOME" LANG='C' LC_ALL='C' GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1' GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM='/dev/null' GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null' GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM='1' GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS='1' GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0' git "$@"
}
phase_c_verify() (
  set -eu -o pipefail
  test "${CODESPACES:-}" = 'true'
  test -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}"
  test "${GH_CONFIG_DIR:-}" = '/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-gh-auth'
  test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT"
  test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$EXEC_ROOT")" = '700'
  test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$EXEC_ROOT")" = "$(command id -u)"
  fs="$(command stat -f -c '%T' "$EXEC_ROOT")"; test "$fs" = 'tmpfs' || test "$fs" = 'ramfs'
  test -d "$EXEC_ROOT/.git"; test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT/.git"
  test -d "$EXEC_ROOT/tools"; test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT/tools"
  test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$CANONICAL_SHA"
  if git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 41; else test "$?" -eq 1; fi
  test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" remote)" = 'origin'
  test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" config --local --get remote.origin.url)" = "$CANONICAL_ORIGIN"
  if git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" ls-files -v | command grep -q '^[a-z]'; then exit 42; fi
  if git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" ls-files -t | command grep -q '^S '; then exit 43; fi
  for p in tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_phase_c_execution_preflight_v1.py tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_writer_key_provisioner_v1.py tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_writer_key_admin_channel_v1.py; do
    entry="$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" ls-tree "$CANONICAL_SHA" -- "$p")"
    mode="${entry%% *}"; rest="${entry#* }"; type="${rest%% *}"; rest="${rest#* }"; oid="${rest%%$'\t'*}"; listed="${rest#*$'\t'}"
    test "$mode" = '100644'; test "$type" = 'blob'; test "$listed" = "$p"
    test -f "$EXEC_ROOT/$p"; test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT/$p"; test ! -x "$EXEC_ROOT/$p"
    test "$(command stat -c '%h' "$EXEC_ROOT/$p")" = '1'
    test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$EXEC_ROOT/$p")" = "$(command id -u)"
    perm="$(command stat -c '%a' "$EXEC_ROOT/$p")"; (( (8#$perm & 022) == 0 ))
    test "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" hash-object --no-filters -- "$p")" = "$oid"
  done
  test -z "$(git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
)
phase_c_bootstrap() (
  set -eu -o pipefail
  test "${CODESPACES:-}" = 'true'; test -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}"
  test "${GH_CONFIG_DIR:-}" = '/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-gh-auth'
  test "${HOME:-}" = '/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-home'
  for p in "$HOME" "$GH_CONFIG_DIR" "$EXEC_ROOT" "$EMPTY_TEMPLATE"; do
    test ! -e "$p"; test ! -L "$p"; command mkdir -m 700 "$p"
    test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$p")" = '700'
    test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$p")" = "$(command id -u)"
    fs="$(command stat -f -c '%T' "$p")"; test "$fs" = 'tmpfs' || test "$fs" = 'ramfs'
  done
  test "$(command awk 'END{print NR}' /proc/swaps)" = '1'
  git_clean clone --no-checkout --no-recurse-submodules --template="$EMPTY_TEMPLATE" "$CANONICAL_ORIGIN" "$EXEC_ROOT"
  test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT"; test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$EXEC_ROOT")" = '700'
  test -d "$EXEC_ROOT/.git"; test ! -L "$EXEC_ROOT/.git"
  git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" config --local core.hooksPath /dev/null
  git_clean -C "$EXEC_ROOT" checkout --detach "$CANONICAL_SHA"
  test ! -e "$EXEC_ROOT/.devcontainer"; test ! -e "$EXEC_ROOT/.devcontainer.json"
  phase_c_verify
)
phase_c_bootstrap
PHASE_C_BOOTSTRAP_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_BOOTSTRAP_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_EXTERNAL_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 90; fi
( phase_c_verify && cd "$EXEC_ROOT" && exec python -B tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_writer_key_admin_channel_v1.py --preauth )
PHASE_C_PREAUTH_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_PREAUTH_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_PREAUTH_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 91; fi
unset PHASE_C_BOOTSTRAP_RC PHASE_C_PREAUTH_RC
command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_EXTERNAL_BOOTSTRAP_AND_PREAUTH_PASS'
literal_sequence.step3_external_reverify_live_preflight:
( phase_c_verify && cd "$EXEC_ROOT" && exec python -B tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_phase_c_execution_preflight_v1.py )
PHASE_C_PREFLIGHT_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_PREFLIGHT_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_PREFLIGHT_FAILED_STOP_NO_APPLY_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 92; fi
unset PHASE_C_PREFLIGHT_RC
literal_sequence.step4_exactly_one_apply_then_session_bou:
phase_c_verify
PHASE_C_VERIFY_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_VERIFY_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_EXTERNAL_ENTRY_VERIFY_FAILED_NO_APPLY' >&2; exit 93; fi
cd "$EXEC_ROOT" || exit 94
PHASE_C_RESULT="$(python -B tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_writer_key_provisioner_v1.py --apply)"
PHASE_C_APPLY_RC=$?
command printf '%s\n' "$PHASE_C_RESULT"
if [ "$PHASE_C_APPLY_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_APPLY_FAILED_DO_NOT_RETRY_DELETE_CODESPACE_AND_RETURN_FOR_RECOVERY_REVIEW' >&2; exit "$PHASE_C_APPLY_RC"; fi
PHASE_C_SESSION_ID="$(command printf '%s\n' "$PHASE_C_RESULT" | python -c 'import json,re,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=d.get("phase_c_session_id",""); assert d.get("status")=="PHASE_C_WRITER_KEY_STORED_PENDING_MANDATORY_CLEANUP" and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}",s); print(s)')" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_SUCCESS_RESULT_PARSE_FAILED_DELETE_CODESPACE_NO_RETRY' >&2; exit 95; }
phase_c_verify
PHASE_C_CLEANUP_VERIFY_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_CLEANUP_VERIFY_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_EXTERNAL_CLEANUP_ENTRY_VERIFY_FAILED_DELETE_CODESPACE_NO_RETRY' >&2; exit 96; fi
python -B tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_writer_key_admin_channel_v1.py --cleanup "$PHASE_C_SESSION_ID" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_LOCAL_CLEANUP_FAILED_DELETE_CODESPACE_NO_RETRY' >&2; exit 97; }
cd / || exit 98
test ! -e "$SESSION_ROOT/$PHASE_C_SESSION_ID.json" || exit 99
command rm -rf -- "$SESSION_ROOT" "$EXEC_ROOT" "$EMPTY_TEMPLATE" "$GH_CONFIG_DIR" "$HOME" || exit 100
command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_LOCAL_TEARDOWN_COMPLETE_CODESPACE_DELETION_STILL_REQUIRED'
unset PHASE_C_SESSION_ID PHASE_C_RESULT PHASE_C_APPLY_RC PHASE_C_VERIFY_RC PHASE_C_CLEANUP_VERIFY_RC
literal_sequence.step5_owner_ui: DELETE DEDICATED CODESPACE IMMEDIATELY; ON ANY FAILURE DELETE WITHOUT RETRY
